name: BoldReview
author: themewant

sections.description:
BoldReview is a powerful WordPress review plugin that lets you collect customer reviews and ratings while also displaying Google Reviews in beautiful, customizable widgets. Whether you run an online store, a business website, or a service platform, BoldReview helps you build trust, create social proof, and increase customer confidence.

With BoldReview, you can collect authentic customer feedback, manage and reply to reviews, and showcase Google Reviews using attractive layouts that match your website’s design. The plugin offers flexible customization options, allowing you to control review settings and display reviews exactly the way you want.

Today, customers rarely purchase a product or service based only on its features. They look at reviews, ratings, and real customer experiences before making a decision. By displaying genuine customer feedback and Google Reviews on your website, BoldReview helps visitors make informed decisions, improves your brand credibility, and can lead to higher conversions and a stronger online reputation.

Live Demo | Join Our Facebook Community | Support | Documentation

🚀 Powerful Features:

👉 Collect reviews and ratings directly from your website visitors.
👉 Display reviews with various graph layouts and rating styles.
👉 Display reviews anywhere with shortcodes.
👉 Flexible review criteria for products and services.
👉 Shortcode integration.
👉 Connect Google business places
👉 User review collection system
👉 Star ratings and custom criteria
👉 Google Business Reviews integration
👉 Automatically fetch the latest Google reviews with your API key.
👉 Review moderation dashboard
👉 Multiple templates and layouts
👉 Frontend shortcodes
👉 Filter reviews by rating
👉 Display reviews with photos
👉 Widget lazy load
👉 Responsive design

⭐ Collection Reviews Features

➤ General Review Settings – Control where review forms appear, who can submit reviews, and how submissions are managed.

➤ Enable Reviews Anywhere – Allow reviews on posts, pages, or any custom post type.

➤ Exclude Specific Pages – Prevent review forms from appearing automatically on selected pages.

➤ Flexible Display Position – Automatically insert review forms before or after content, or place them manually with a shortcode.

➤ Admin Email Notifications – Receive an email whenever a new review is submitted.

➤ Submission Limits – Limit how many reviews each user can submit per post.

➤ Registered Users Only – Restrict review submissions to logged-in users.

➤ Auto Review Approval – Publish reviews instantly or require moderation before they go live.

➤ User & Author Reviews – Enable visitor reviews and display the author’s overall rating.

➤ Review Pagination – Control how many reviews appear per page.

➤ Multiple Rating Input Styles – Choose from Stars, Sliders, Bars, Squares, or Pills for rating input.

➤ Custom Review Form Fields – Enable, disable, or require fields like Name, Email, Website, Title, and Review.

➤ Custom Criteria Groups – Create multiple rating criteria for different products, services, or content.

➤ Multiple Rating Summary Styles – Display review summaries with Bars, Points, Pie Charts, Gauges, Tiles, and more.

➤ Average Rating Display – Show the overall average score for each criteria group.

➤ Flexible Review Templates – Choose different frontend layouts for displaying reviews.

➤ Toggle Review Elements – Show or hide avatars, ratings, dates, titles, reviewer emails, websites, and more.

🌍 Google Business Reviews Features

➤ Google Business Integration – Connect your Google Business Profile using your own Google Places API key.

➤ Automatic Review Sync – Automatically fetch and refresh Google reviews at scheduled intervals.

➤ Review Accumulation – Store previously fetched reviews to display more than Google’s default limit over time.

➤ Review Card Controls – Show or hide reviewer photos, ratings, Google logo, verified badges, business replies, and navigation arrows.

➤ Rating Filter – Display only reviews that meet your selected minimum star rating.

➤ Flexible Date Formats – Choose relative dates or standard date formats.

➤ Review Text Display – Show full reviews, truncate with a “Read More” toggle, or display them in a scrollable area.

➤ Maximum Review Limit – Control how many Google reviews are displayed on your website.

➤ Responsive Review Cards – Display Google reviews beautifully on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

👋 WHAT’S NEXT?

If you like BoldReview plugin, then consider checking our other WordPress Plugins:

🖼️ Themewant Product Gallery – Advanced WooCommerce Product Gallery with image slider, variation gallery, video support, zoom, lightbox, and 360° product view.

💱 Easy Currency – Display and switch WooCommerce prices in multiple currencies with auto-updated rates and seamless checkout.

🏨 Easy Hotel Booking – A simple yet powerful hotel booking solution for WordPress with room management, availability calendar, and online reservations.

📋 RT Mega Menu – Build stunning, fully customizable mega menus for WordPress with drag-and-drop ease and responsive layouts.

📄 BoldForm Lite – Create contact forms, registration forms, surveys, and more with an intuitive drag-and-drop builder for WordPress.

📄 Templateon – Import, customize, and launch beautiful Elementor websites without starting from scratch.

💚 Satisfied with BoldReview plugin ?
⭐ Rate us on WordPress — Your Review, Our Inspiration!

External services

This plugin connects to the Google Maps Platform (Google Places API and Google Maps JavaScript API) to power the optional Google Business Reviews feature. It is only used when you enable the Google Reviews module and connect a Google Business Profile using your own Google API key.

What the plugin sends, and when:

  • When you search for a business in the admin (Connect Google tab), the text you type, plus your Google API key, is sent to Google so matching places can be suggested.
  • When you connect a place and when reviews are refreshed, the selected Place ID and your API key are sent to Google to retrieve the business details, rating, reviews and profile/photo images.
  • On the admin settings screen, the Google Maps JavaScript API is loaded from Google to assist with place search.

No data from your site visitors is sent to Google by this plugin. Requests are made server-to-server (or, for the Maps JavaScript API, from the admin screen only).

Endpoints used:

  • https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/autocomplete/json
  • https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/details/json
  • https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/photo
  • https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js
  • https://places.googleapis.com/v1/places:searchText
  • https://places.googleapis.com/v1/places/
  • https://places.googleapis.com/v1/

Google is a third-party service. Its use is subject to Google’s terms and privacy policy:

  • Google Maps Platform Terms of Service: https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms/
  • Google APIs Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/terms/
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Social sharing services

The Google Reviews layouts include an optional “Share” button on each review card. When a site visitor clicks “Share” and then chooses a network, the plugin opens that network’s own share page in a new tab. No data is sent automatically: a request is only made when the visitor actively chooses a network, and the only information passed is the page URL of the review (and, for some networks, a generic “Check this out!” message). The plugin does not transmit any visitor data on its own.

The share targets, and what is sent when a visitor clicks them, are:

  • Facebook (Meta) — opens https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php with the page URL. Terms: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms , Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
  • WhatsApp — opens https://api.whatsapp.com/send with the page URL as message text. Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service , Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
  • X (Twitter) — opens https://twitter.com/intent/tweet with the page URL and a generic message. Terms: https://x.com/en/tos , Privacy: https://x.com/en/privacy
  • Email via Gmail — opens https://mail.google.com/mail/ pre-filled with the page URL and a generic message. Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms , Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to BoldReview in the admin sidebar to configure.
  4. Use [bold_review_form post_id="123"] and [bold_reviews post_id="123"] shortcodes.
sections.faq:
Can visitors submit reviews from the frontend?

Yes. Visitors can submit reviews and ratings using the built-in review form.

Can I moderate reviews before they are published?

Yes. You can review, approve, edit, or delete submissions from the admin dashboard.

Does BoldReview support Google Business Reviews?

Yes. You can connect and display Google Business Reviews on your website using the Google Reviews module.

Can I display reviews anywhere on my site?

Yes. Reviews and review forms can be displayed using shortcodes on posts, pages, and widgets:

  • [bold_review_form] – the reviews list plus the submission form.
  • [bold_reviews] – the reviews list only (with the rating summary).

Both shortcodes accept these optional attributes:

  • post_id – show reviews for a specific post/page (defaults to the current one).
  • limit – how many reviews to load per page.
  • paged – which page of reviews to start on.
  • summary_style – override the rating-summary design for this shortcode only: bars, point, pie, hbars, stripes, gauge, tiles, or overview.
  • input_style – override the form’s rating-input control for this shortcode only: stars, slider, bar, square, or pill.

When summary_style / input_style are omitted (or invalid) the shortcode falls back to the styles configured in the admin settings. Example: [bold_review_form summary_style="pie" input_style="pill"].

Is BoldReview mobile-friendly?

Yes. All review forms and review layouts are fully responsive and work well on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
